children: The new global SUV will join Hyundai’s India line-up, with more details expected to be revealed in the coming weeks
Hyundai Motor India has revealed the name of its upcoming SUV, Bayon, giving the first glimpse of a new model that is set to join its growing SUV portfolio.

Hyundai Bayon is a new global SUV being introduced for an evolving Indian market. Hyundai said the model brings together its global design and product philosophy with technology and a focus on creating a more intuitive driving experience.
The Bayon is expected to add a new dimension to Hyundai’s SUV line-up, although the company has not yet shared details about its engine options, features, dimensions or pricing.

The name Bayon is inspired by Bayonne, a city in France’s Basque Country. Hyundai said the city’s distinctive character and dynamic spirit influenced the name, which also reflects the company’s global design approach.
Along with the name announcement, Hyundai has released a film introducing Bayon. The film uses a futuristic laboratory setting, where different elements come together to form the SUV’s name.
The company said the film represents the coming together of intelligence, design and technology, and ends with the message “Intelligence ON”.
